card.name: Inside URLs and drug names
card.fires_on: Fires on a piece in the middle of an unusual run-together string, such as a web address or a drug name, just before the string is completed. Examples are the end of REMSPCG in an FDA link, the ven in desvenlafaxine, and EL in ZEPZELCA.
